title: dora
description: DORAOracle — 15 tools for DORA Art.5-32: risk register, ICT incidents, TLPT, third-party.
summary: DORAOracle — 15 tools for DORA Art.5-32: risk register, ICT incidents, TLPT, third-party.
offersHint: DORAOracle — 15 tools for DORA Art.5-32: risk register, ICT incidents, TLPT, third-party. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://tooloracle.io/dora/mcp/

toolsPreview.name: cve_search
toolsPreview.description: Search CVEs by keyword, vendor or product. Returns CVSS scores, attack vectors, DORA pillar mapping.

toolsPreview.name: cve_latest
toolsPreview.description: Latest critical CVEs — daily DORA ICT risk briefing. Filter by severity and banking relevance.

toolsPreview.name: kev_list
toolsPreview.description: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities — actively exploited CVEs with patch deadlines. DORA Art. 9 patch compliance.

toolsPreview.name: kev_check
toolsPreview.description: Check if a specific CVE is in CISA KEV (actively exploited in the wild). Returns DORA incident classification guidance.

toolsPreview.name: cert_advisories
toolsPreview.description: CERT-Bund security advisories — authoritative DE source for ICT threats. DORA Art. 17 threat monitoring.

toolsPreview.name: breach_check
toolsPreview.description: HaveIBeenPwned breach database — check domain/company breach exposure. DORA Art. 18 incident assessment.

toolsPreview.name: threat_actors
toolsPreview.description: Feodo Tracker: live C2 botnet servers (Emotet, QakBot, etc.). Actionable IP blocklist for DORA Art. 9.

toolsPreview.name: incident_timeline
toolsPreview.description: Generate a DORA Art. 19-aligned ICT incident reporting timeline with the regulatory deadline structure. Supports - does not constitute - compliant reporting.

toolsPreview.name: mitre_techniques
toolsPreview.description: MITRE ATT&CK techniques for DORA TLPT / TIBER-EU penetration testing. Maps to DORA Art. 26.

toolsPreview.name: tlpt_scenarios
toolsPreview.description: TIBER-EU threat scenarios for DORA resilience testing planning. Banking-specific attack simulations.

toolsPreview.name: cloud_status
toolsPreview.description: Live status of AWS, GCP, Azure cloud providers. DORA Art. 28 third-party ICT risk monitoring.

toolsPreview.name: provider_risk
toolsPreview.description: DORA Art. 28 ICT third-party risk assessment: CVE history, news, GLEIF registration, contractual checklist.

toolsPreview.name: dora_news
toolsPreview.description: EBA/DORA regulatory news for banks. Topics: general, eba, incident, third_party, testing, guidelines, bafin, swift.

toolsPreview.name: dora_calendar
toolsPreview.description: DORA compliance milestones and upcoming deadlines for financial institutions. All Art. references included.

toolsPreview.name: health_check
toolsPreview.description: DORAOracle server status and all backend connectivity checks.
